crystal_phase.CoMo: mixed phase of Co7Mo6 alloy and metallic Mo

proof_in_the_paper: The (001) surface of rhombohedral Co7Mo6 structure and the (111) surface of cubic CMN structure were modeled with a 2 × 2 slab for CM and CMN catalysts, respectively, in which the top two layers of atoms and the coordination of H and O were relaxed. (4,45−47)
